summary: Model the parameter aliasing of a mapped arguments exotic object in non-strict functions with a simple parameter list.

target.notes: Mapped indices and corresponding parameter bindings share state until mapping is broken by specified property operations. A copied C# array is not equivalent.

semantics.direction: arguments[index] writes can update parameter and parameter writes can update mapped index

caveats: Deleting/redefining an index can sever the parameter map.
Duplicate parameter names have subtle mapping rules; helper construction must follow CreateMappedArgumentsObject.
